decisions.reason: A formwork profile line close to the core offer, presented on its own page, lets the R&D-active firm interpret results and refine it.
Automated distributor flow control builds on established equipment and fits the automation strategy, so the firm can assimilate feedback and improve it.
A shuttering magnet line is close to the firm's formwork expertise, so its existing knowledge supports learning and improvement even with only a website mention.
A magnetic formwork strip line with its own page is a core-adjacent offer the firm can readily develop further.
A magnetic formwork component on its own page builds directly on related knowledge and in-house R&D.
Close to the core offer, though its low visibility and overlap with other magnetic components slightly raise the risk of consolidation.
